top_choice_rationale: P002 pairs two distinct achievements whose chemistry is measured directly and has been reproduced independently: base editing (Liu alone) as a programmable chemical conversion of single DNA bases without double-strand cleavage, and PROTAC degraders (Crews, Deshaies) as the 2001 concept that turned ubiquitin-proteasome biochemistry into a design principle. It stays within the three-laureate cap and the base-editing citation is worded to separate it from the 2020 CRISPR prize. P001 is a close second because it is the single coherent achievement with the broadest support and gives Ciulli's ligand chemistry its due, at the cost of leaving out base editing. P003 is mature and cleanly attributed but overlaps the 2010 cross-coupling prize. No award is ranked last because several candidacies are mature and well supported.
